name: mission-donation-platform
description: The free donation plugin for nonprofits. Powerful features, modern forms, no add-ons required.

scripts.build: npm run build:blocks && npm run build:admin
scripts.start: npm run start:blocks & npm run start:admin
scripts.lint:js: wp-scripts lint-js blocks/src admin/src assets/shared specs
scripts.i18n:pot: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/mission-donation-platform php -d memory_limit=1024M /usr/local/bin/wp i18n make-pot . languages/mission-donation-platform.pot --slug=mission-donation-platform --domain=mission-donation-platform --exclude=node_modules,vendor,tests,artifacts,specs,tasks
scripts.i18n:json: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/mission-donation-platform wp i18n make-json languages --no-purge --pretty-print && npm run i18n:fix
scripts.i18n:po: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/mission-donation-platform wp i18n update-po languages/mission-donation-platform.pot languages
scripts.i18n:mo: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/mission-donation-platform wp i18n make-mo languages
scripts.i18n: npm run i18n:pot && npm run i18n:po && npm run i18n:mo && npm run i18n:json
scripts.plugin-zip: npm run build && find admin/build blocks/build -name '*.map' -delete && composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader && wp-scripts plugin-zip && composer install
